drives.description: Build enterprise-grade distributed systems and scalable multi-tenant cloud backends.
Work on hyper-scale Azure infrastructure, hypervisors, and storage primitives.
Develop highly available customer-facing cloud APIs with ultra-low latency guarantees.
Design next-generation SDN controllers, telemetry tools, and zero-trust routers.
Develop core enterprise banking platforms and distributed transactional engines.
Pre-silicon architecture modeling and FPGA emulation.
